review.reviewer: Implementation owner after independent review of 335f5d76
review.decision: Check launch targets, transaction completion and first admission at their real entry points.
review.notes: Only isolated homes and operator-owned processes.

cases.setup: Use a private home, a saved service plan, known launch targets and original data identity.
cases.action: Check incompatible and updated binaries, an open writer, and resume after the old group marker has been published.
cases.expected: Refuse the old binary or an open writer before mutation. Finish the recorded group before the next layout and preserve data identity.

cases.setup: Start in a home with no existing storage root.
cases.action: Inspect using the normal Doctor admission, then enter through the CLI writer or menu initialization.
cases.expected: The inspection leaves the root absent. Both first writers observe the verified purpose layout.
